name: Aubergine & hummus grills
assumptions: Yield estimated from typical BBC Good Food / Turkish meze-style recipe with 2 aubergines producing 8-12 slices total, allowing 2-3 grills per serving plus side salad.
Total time is sum of active and passive steps: ~15 min initial grilling + ~3 min second grilling + ~10-12 min prep and assembly.
Hummus assumed to contain sesame (tahini) and possibly chickpeas/soy; bread assumed to be wheat-based; walnuts are tree nuts; no dairy, eggs, fish, or shellfish listed.
Vegan status null due to potential honey or non-vegan bread/hummus in commercial products; gluten-free is false due to bread and possible cross-contamination in hummus.
Parsley, tomatoes, lemon, oils, and aubergine introduce no listed allergens.
instructions:
step 1
Lay the aubergine out in one layer on a large baking sheet. Brush sparingly with vegetable oil, then season generously. Grill for 15 mins, turning twice and brushing with oil until the slices are softened and cooked through. Meanwhile, whizz the bread into crumbs. Add 2 tsp oil and whizz briefly again, to coat.

step 2
Spread a couple of tsps of hummus on top of each slice of aubergine. Tip the breadcrumbs onto a large plate, then press the hummus side of the aubergines into the crumbs to coat. Grill again, crumb-side up, for about 3 mins until golden.

step 3
Toss the walnuts, parsley and cherry tomatoes in a bowl, season, then add the lemon juice and olive oil and toss again. Serve the grills with the salad, a dollop more hummus and some pitta bread.

ingredients.name: Aubergine
ingredients.assumptions: 2 medium aubergines, each ~300g raw edible portion

ingredients.name: Vegetable Oil
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tbsp vegetable oil for brushing aubergine slices

ingredients.name: Bread
ingredients.assumptions: 3 thin slices white bread (~25g each) turned into crumbs

ingredients.name: Hummus
ingredients.assumptions: 300g plain hummus (used in two parts: most for topping, remainder as serving dollop)

ingredients.name: Parsley
ingredients.assumptions: 40g fresh flat-leaf parsley, leaves and stems

ingredients.name: Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients.assumptions: 200g raw cherry tomatoes, halved for salad

ingredients.name: Lemon
ingredients.assumptions: Juice from half a medium lemon (~25g juice only, no peel or pith)

ingredients.name: Extra Virgin Olive Oil
ingredients.assumptions: Splash of extra virgin olive oil for dressing (~10g / 2 tsp plausible for light salad toss)
